acceptanceCriteria: A spec defines a read-only plan-time adapter event (host-neutral, Claude Code ExitPlanMode first) whose output carries resolved anchors, affected checks and governing authority with the usual uncertainty and abstention rules.
The event never blocks or approves a plan on its own authority; it reports evidence and degradations only, and is not an input to ranking or learning.
A frozen evaluation measures whether plan-time evidence changes plan scope accuracy before it is advertised.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Idea from reviewing backnotprop/plannotator (2026-10-06): it hooks Claude Code's PermissionRequest on ExitPlanMode so every agent plan passes a review step, with diffs between plan revisions and structured feedback returned to the agent. Corvint already injects context at SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, but nothing evaluates the plan itself, which is the cheapest moment to catch a wrong scope. A plan-time event could resolve the plan's file and requirement anchors, attach affected-plan impact and governing authority, and flag plan steps that touch paths outside the declared scope, all read-only and advisory.
title: Plan-time hook: attach Corvint context and impact evidence when an agent submits a plan (ExitPlanMode), before code is written
